About.label: About me
About.intro: <name>I’m Rafif Muhammad Muflihur Rodwa</name>, a UI/UX designer based in Banyuwangi, Indonesia. I design clear, intuitive digital experiences, supported by a background in frontend development and graphic design.
About.experience: I’ve been working in frontend development and graphic design since 2024, and focusing on UI/UX design since September 2025. My work connects user journeys and interface design in Figma with implementation using React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS.
About.personal: I’ve been a co-founder of <company>Micholabs</company> since its founding in September 2025, bringing design and development together to turn ideas into useful digital experiences. Outside of work, I enjoy exploring new technologies, writing, experimenting with ideas, trading, and farming.
